notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
You control at least one additional creature with mana value 2 or less that can be cast using colored mana.
description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {1}{U}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers twice, creating two copies of a Treasure token you control.
When Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and another creature with mana value 2 or less that can be cast using colored mana from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 4 one additional time if you do not have enough mana to cast the other creature returned to your hand in step 3.
Cast the other creature returned to your hand in step 3 by paying its mana cost.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers twice, creating two copies of a Treasure token you control.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
